name: Tyro Of The Gauntlet
description: Origin Feat You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Stand as One
features.description: When an ally within 5 feet of you is subjected to an effect that would push or pull it, you can take a Reaction to prevent that ally from being pushed or pulled. To receive this benefit, the ally can’t have the Incapacitated condition.

features.name: Vigilant
features.description: When you take the Ready action, the next attack roll made against you has Disadvantage before the start of your next turn.
